display_information.name: Radius Agent
display_information.description: Dogfood agent for x402 APIs and EVM wallet ops on Radius and Base, with an on-chain paper trail.
display_information.long_description: Radius Agent is a Hermes agent deployed on Railway for the Radius team to dogfood agentic commerce. Mention it in #initiative-agentic-commerce-platform or DM it to: call and pay x402 APIs (demo catalog at grug402.dev) on Radius Testnet (SBC, Permit2) and Base Sepolia (USDC, EIP-3009); check wallet balances and send SBC; look up transaction status; and pull a ledger of every payment attempt with explorer links. Mainnet payments are disabled by default and every call is capped per request.

agent_view.agent_description: Pay x402 APIs and run wallet ops on Radius and Base.
